full_judgment:
3. Plaintiff opposite party No. 1 instituted Title Suit No. 200 of 1980 in the court of Sub-ordinate Judge, 1st Court, Khulna against petitioners and others for establishment of title and recovery of khas possession and compensation on the allegation contending inter alia that the land under CS khatian No. 1001 of Mouza Baniakhamar, Police Station Khulna, District Khulna originally belonged to Poilan Sheikh, Badulla Sheikh and Shahamatullah Sheikh in equal share in rayioti right and their names were recorded properly. Of them, Shahamatullah was in exclusive possession of plot No. 3642, Badullah in plot No. 3643 and Ahadullah Sheikh and others were in possession in plot No. 3644 as a right of exchange and their names were mentioned in remark column in the khatian that there was an exchange in between Ahadullah Sheikh and Poilan Sheikh and Ahadullah Sheikh got the land of plot No. 3644; Rahamatullah and others filed Title Suit No. 184 of 1914 and in that suit Ahadullah Sheikh and others were defendant Nos. 1-3 and Poilan Sheikh and others were defendant Nos. 4-10 and they compromised by filing compromise petition separately and in that suit the exchange of Ahadullah Sheikh was admitted and the land Poilan Sheikh got, was admitted; the land which Poilan Sheikh got was again exchanged with Kutubullah Sheikh and others and transferred the land of plot No. 3644 to Heralal Datta by kabala dated 13-9-1927; on the same date, Heralal Datta transferred 1.20 acres of land by patta to Ismail Sheikh including the suit land; for arrears of rent, Heralal Datta filed Rent Suit No. 1782 of 1942 in the court of the then Munsif, 3rd Court, Khulna, the said suit was dismissed for non prosecution. It is further case of plaintiffs that Ismail Sheikh had title over the suit land of plot Nos. 3671 and 3670/4246 under CS khatian No. 2666 and the said land has been situated adjacent south-east side of the suit land; in the year 1954 AD Ismail Sheikh reconstructed the houses on the suit plot and also constructed more 3 rooms and those were tenanted and thereafter, he shifted his house on the land of plot Nos. 3671 and 2670/4246. In SA record the suit land was recorded in SA khatian No. 1015 and the tenant, defaulted to pay rent and Ismail Sheikh filed two SCC Suit being Nos. 108 of 1958 and 71 of 1059 and those were decreed. Momin Mollik also defaulted to pay rent and the landlord, Ismail Sheikh filed Money Suit No. 12 of 1960 and the suit was decreed. Momin Mollik filed Money Suit No. 34 of 1960 which was allowed and thereafter, defendant Nos. 1-6 got possession of the suit land and houses there on. Thereafter, Ismail Sheikh filed Title Suit No. 263 of 1966 which was transferred to the court of Sub-ordinate Judge, Additional Court, Khulna and the same was dismissed. Against which Ismail Sheikh filed Appeal from Original Decree No. 127 of 1976 before in the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. The suit having running with formal defects, plaintiffs of that suit filed application for withdrawal of the suit with permission to sue afresh. The application was allowed on 7-4-1980. Before that date, the instant suit was filed on 13-3-1980. Momena Bibi and Jomiron Nessa transferred some decimals of land from plot No. 3643 along with other land to Heralal Datta by Kabala dated 9-6-1931 and thereafter, the said land was transferred to Paban Sheikh, son of Poilan Sheikh by a registered lease deed on 26-3-1942 and on that deed there was a statement that Ismail Sheikh is in possession on plot No. 3644 and adjacent west side of plot No. 3643. Title suit No. 208 of 1961 filed by heirs of Shahamatullah was dismissed and in that suit, right of Ismail Sheikh was admitted that the suit land was investigated. Title suit No. 33 of 1963 was filed by defendant Nos. 1-6, was dismissed for default, hence the suit. 

 4. In the suit the predecessor of these petitioners as defendant Nos. 1 and 6 contested by filing written statement contending inter alia that, remark column of the CS khatian showing amaze possession of Ahadullah in respect of plot No. 3644 is wrong as there was no amaze with Ahadullah Sheikh.
